meta.description: Registry for recursive selection-stability conditions in Phase 3.

selection_stability_entries.name: Selection Stability Under Recursion
selection_stability_entries.purpose: Represent bounded recursive selection behavior without collapsing nondeterministic continuation structure.

selection_stability_conditions.name: recursive_selection_remains_admissible
selection_stability_conditions.description: Each selected recursive update must satisfy current admissibility constraints.

selection_stability_conditions.name: branch_retention_remains_bounded
selection_stability_conditions.description: The number of concurrent process branches does not diverge under recursive selection.

selection_stability_conditions.name: orientation_drift_remains_bounded
selection_stability_conditions.description: Deviation from the base orientation frame stays within the recurrence-basin limits.

selection_stability_conditions.name: transport_flux_remains_finite
selection_stability_conditions.description: Transition flux does not exhibit infinite growth per recursive step.

selection_stability_conditions.name: selection_does_not_force_unique_continuation
selection_stability_conditions.description: Recursive selection logic does not bypass multi-valued continuation where required.

selection_stability_conditions.name: delta_nondeterminism_preserved
selection_stability_conditions.description: Core delta non-determinism remains active across the recursion chain.

selection_stability_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_witness
selection_stability_conditions.description: Pruning does not result in an empty admissible candidate set during recursive updates.

selection_stability_conditions.name: residue_accumulation_does_not_force_basin_escape
selection_stability_conditions.description: Residue update sequence remains below the threshold for regime switching or basin escape.
